<a id="summary"></a>

## Summary

req-0054 (magpie 2026-09-02, msg 888D45C1): a ruling to a working omp returned `queued, reason:human-typing` and delivered on attempt 101, eight minutes late. Omp/Pi must bypass both composer gates and `select_rung`, entering the queue-backed Observe/message.pushed path immediately; the extension claims and acknowledges the row after injecting it at turn end. Correction 2026-09-02: the production `Transport` is Claude-only `UdsTransport`; the Omp/Pi extension stream is the event bus plus inbox claim, not a Transport. A second unit adds sender-visible still-queued and delivered-late notices.

<a id="goals"></a>

## Goals

- A message to a working omp/pi seat is handed to the extension stream immediately; no composer capture or human-typing veto for those harnesses.
- A row still queued after N seconds (config, default 60) raises a pushed notice to the sender naming msg_id, recipient, reason, and attempts; later delivery raises delivered late, and the sender's next pij-rs command prints outstanding notices on stderr.

<a id="non-goals"></a>

## Non-goals

- Changing the veto for Claude/Copilot/Codex panes, where a human composer can exist.
- Any OMP extension change beyond what the stream already does.
- Restarting the production rs daemon or running any flowspace3 daemon.
